subject: general
question: By selling an article at 66(2)/(3)% of the actual selling price, a loss of 25% is incurred. What is the profit percentage on selling the article at its actual selling price?
solution:
**Given:**

The loss percentage = 25%

**Formula used:**

P = SP - CP Where, P = Profit, SP = Selling price, and CP = Cost price

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the article be C and the selling price of the article be S

According to the question

⇒ {{2over 3}S} = {{3over 4}{C}}

⇒ {S = {9over 8}C} ----(1)

When an article sold on the actual selling price

Profit percentage = {SP - CPover CP} times 100

Where, SP = S, and CP = C

⇒ {S - Cover C} times 100

By equation (1)

⇒ {{9over 8}C - {C}over C} times 100

⇒ {9 - 8over 8} times 100 = 12.5\% 

**∴ The required result will be 12.5%.**
